main_text.p: fignans. Ssnstt, autem hic, ut & in plu-ribus aliis vocibus, tum præcedentibus, tum subsequentibus, adjectitia est particula, idem valens ac apud nos & Sax. nefle, & npsse, Teut. best; & hepo, in nominum substantivorum terminatione.
Ʀtbarɪdoȹ, Denudasti: sic nobis compositum, Openbaeren. Rebarnust, Revelatione] Nudus, nobis Anglis, bare ; denudare, to make bare.

Ʀuecont, Fumigabant: quia Roof, Fumus: sed & alio sensu, Rtecbon sun, Fumigabunt, ab odore] Fumus, Sax. pec; fumare, peocan, unde nostrum reeke, fumus: item to reeke, Belg. Rooken, fumare. Ifthinc etiam (forte) nubium ex vento motum, nos racke dicimus.
Roowarthan, Movebitur] Hinc forte Cœlum noœpe Sax. dictum, à movendo scil. quia semper movet: Warthan nihil aliud hic nisi verbi passivi futuri temporis nota.

page.notes: Several words in the Old Saxon/Teutonic glosses are in black letter and rendered approximately; marks near "Limi" and the small marginal scribbles are illegible. Left margin and right margin contain no legible printed notes. Greek-looking Teutonic forms are approximate.
